propositions: Package-free by-path loading of reconcile.py fails with ModuleNotFoundError when calling _commit_binding_store_snapshot() due to unconditional rebar_reconciler.git_adapter import at reconcile_helpers.py:200.
Standalone reconcile.py creates a loader key and loads reconcile_helpers under a flat key without creating an importable parent package, preventing the absolute import from resolving.

The helper must resolve git_adapter through the existing sibling loader using canonical key rebar_reconciler.git_adapter and file git_adapter.py to support both standalone and package-context execution.

The fix must preserve module identity so that package-context and standalone execution reuse the same sys.modules["rebar_reconciler.git_adapter"] object and maintain all existing True/False/error semantics.
Standalone commit-back with no state files must return True, and operational git failures must return False with diagnostic output.
The repair is scoped to the import seam in _commit_binding_store_snapshot() and does not alter git operation behavior or introduce new dependencies.
